mipContract: ceil upper bound of each RGBA8 2x2 box-average mip; all bilinear supports; trilinear is convex mixture; actual GPU-generated mip chain must be audited before adoption
interpretation: Strict whole-triangle rejection preserves every original vertex. Split-envelope clipping preserves static affine interpolation but recomputes nonlinear vertex wind/normal; displacement upper bound is reported separately. Convex envelope preserves all islands and interior transparent gaps; it is not a hole triangulation.
